title: Teamwork
info: Passing gives your team more choices than dribbling alone every time.
Encouraging a teammate who missed a shot helps the team. Laughing at them does not.
Shaking hands or saying well played after the match is part of the game.

options: Give a teammate a better chance
Hide the ball from the referee
Help teammates know where you are

A team that passes and defends together
